summary: Harvard Ave Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC with units (HAVAU), Class A shares (HAVA), and rights (HAVAR) on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K announcing a September 25, 2026 business combination agreement with OAG International Ltd. Under the structure, PubCo OAG Pipeline Technologies Inc. will acquire HAVA via a first merger, then OAG via a second merger, with both becoming PubCo subsidiaries. HAVA and OAG shareholders will receive PubCo ordinary shares and become PubCo shareholders. No per-share price, premium, or fee was disclosed. Closing remains subject to conditions; watch shareholder redemptions and regulatory clearances.
